title: Landing de cadastro exige licença válida para mostrar QR
description: Produto real: /cadastro/:licenca NÃO tem formulário HTML. Compara licença válida (QR/CTA WhatsApp) vs inválida (Consultor não encontrado).

steps.description: Navigate to /cadastro/tvmensal12
Verify QR Code or CTA "Abrir WhatsApp Agora" / "Escaneie o QR Code" is visible
Verify there is a wa.me link OR QR SVG and no Nome/CPF registration inputs are required
Navigate to /cadastro/licenca-inexistente-e2e-xyz
Verify text "Consultor não encontrado" (or equivalent safe error) is displayed

title: Log in and reach the admin dashboard shell
description: Consultant signs in and lands on /admin shell with sidebar. Do NOT require deep route hrefs like /admin/motor on the dashboard DOM (SPA tabs).

steps.description: Navigate to /auth
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
If cookie banner appears, click Aceitar; if product tour appears, click Encerrar tour
Verify URL contains /admin
Verify sidebar or title shows Painel OR Clientes interessados OR Captação

title: Landing de cadastro mostra CTA WhatsApp (wa.me)
description: Lead abre /cadastro/tvmensal12 e vê CTA para WhatsApp. NÃO preencher formulário Nome/CPF (não existe). NÃO clicar até WhatsApp Web externo.

steps.description: Navigate to /cadastro/tvmensal12
Accept cookies if a banner appears
Verify button/link "Abrir WhatsApp Agora" OR "Clique aqui para abrir" is visible
Verify an href containing wa.me exists (do not navigate away to WhatsApp Web)

title: Acesso autenticado redireciona para login quando a sessão não está presente
description: Verifies that protected admin pages send an unauthenticated user to the login page instead of showing protected content.
category: route guard redirects from protected pages to /auth

steps.description: Navigate to /admin
Verify the login page is displayed
Navigate to /super-admin
Verify the login page is displayed

title: Consultor abre uma conversa e continua o atendimento no WhatsApp
description: Verifies that a logged-in consultant can open a client conversation, review the iGreen context, and use the message composer to continue the lead flow.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the WhatsApp clients area
Open a client conversation
Verify the iGreen conversation context is displayed
Verify the message composer is available
